armySpecialRules.name: TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this rule may re-roll the lowest dice roll for their flee distance when choosing Flee as a charge reaction.

armySpecialRules.name: ZEALOTRY
armySpecialRules.description: Units with this rule counts as having one rank more than they actually have when determining if they are Steadfast. In addition, they have the Cold-blooded special rule for any Break tests taken in the first round of combat.

magicItems.name: BEDAYAH
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon gains +3 Weapon Skill and the Always Strikes First special rule.

magicItems.name: DHAMI, THE BLACK SWORD OF ANTAR
magicItems.description: The wielder gains +1 To Wound and the Lightning Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: SUNSPEAR
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon gains +1 To Hit and may re-roll failed rolls To Wound.

magicItems.name: BLADE OF HOLY WRATH
magicItems.description: The wielder gains a Strength bonus equal to the Wound characteristics of any enemy model he Hits in close combat.

magicItems.name: FIRE EATER
magicItems.description: The wielder of this item gains a Breath Weapon with Strength 4 and the Flaming Attack special rule. In addition, they gain the Immunity (Flaming Attacks) special rule.

magicItems.name: BOW OF SEEKING
magicItems.description: Shots fired with this weapon are resolved at Strength 4 and have the Sniper special rule.

magicItems.name: EBONY BOW
magicItems.description: Shots fired with this weapon are resolved at Strength 5 and have the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule.

magicItems.name: EFREET'S BLADE
magicItems.description: This weapon can be activated at the start of any round of Close Combat. For the remainder of the round, the model gains +3 Strength and Attacks as well as the Flaming Attacks and Multiple Wounds (D3) special rules.

magicItems.name: HORN OF THE AL-MIRAJ
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon gains the Killing Blow and Terror and special rules against War Beasts, Cavalry, Monstrous Infantry, Monstrous Cavalry and Chariots.

magicItems.name: THE DAGGER OF THE GRAND MASTER
magicItems.description: Nominate one enemy character at the start of the battle. The wielder of the Dagger will wound that model on a 2+. In addition, that model must re-roll successful armour saves against Wounds caused by this weapon.

magicItems.name: THE THIRSTING BLADE
magicItems.description: The wielder gains the Frenzy special rule. For every 6 rolled To Hit, they gain +1 Attack. These additional Attacks can also generate additional Attacks. However, every time the wielder rolls a 1 To Hit, they must resolve a Hit against themselves instead.

magicItems.name: SHIELD OF FAITH
magicItems.description: The bearer gains a Ward save (5+). If the bearer is wounded by an enemy with a magical weapon but passes their Ward save, the enemies weapon is destroyed.

magicItems.name: SCALES OF AL-TINNIN
magicItems.description: The wearer gains the Natural Armour (6+) and Terror special rules.

magicItems.name: ARMOUR OF DEFLECTION
magicItems.description: For every successful armour save the wearer of this item makes in close combat, the attacking model suffers back a Hit using the same Strength and special rules as they used to attack.

magicItems.name: HELM OF THE SUN'S WRATH
magicItems.description: This item adds a 6+ armour save. This item gives the wearer the Immunity (Flaming Attacks) and Hatred special rules.

magicItems.name: BRACERS OF THE SNAKE
magicItems.description: This item adds a 6+ armour save. One enemy model in base contact, chosen by the bearer, suffer -1 penalty to their Attack characteristic.

magicItems.name: SCORPION ARMOUR
magicItems.description: The wearer has the Natural Armour (5+) and Poisoned Attacks special rules.

magicItems.name: RING OF DIVINE HEALING
magicItems.description: At the start of each player’s turn, the ring will restore one lost Wound suffered earlier in the game, up to the model's starting value.

magicItems.name: ORB OF ILLUSION
magicItems.description: Roll a D6 for every Hit the bearer suffers in close combat. On a 1-3, the Hit is ignored.

magicItems.name: TALISMANIC TUNIC OF THE ONE
magicItems.description: This item gives the wearer a 5+ Ward save. In addition, the wearer may re-roll armour save rolls of 1.

magicItems.name: HABOOB CLOAK
magicItems.description: All close combat attacks against the wearer suffer -1 To Hit. In addition, the wearer and any unit they join always counts as being in soft cover.

magicItems.name: HAND OF FATIMA
magicItems.description: This item gives the bearer the Magic Resistance (1) special rule. In addition, they may re-roll one roll To Hit, To Wound or when taking armour or Ward saves per turn.

magicItems.name: NAZAR AMULET
magicItems.description: The first time the wielder or their unit is targeted by an enemy spell, it is automatically dispelled.

magicItems.name: THE SUN OF KNOWLEDGE
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gain a +D3 casting bonus to each of their spell casting attempts and the Loremaster special rule. However, if they roll a Miscast, they must add their casting bonus from this item to the result on the Miscast table.

magicItems.name: BOOK OF HIDDEN THINGS
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item may re-roll any failed Dispel attempts.

magicItems.name: THE AIM OF THE SAGE
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item may roll an additional free dice when casting spells from the Lore of the Heavens, and discard one dice of their choice.

magicItems.name: ENCHANTED PUZZLEBOX
magicItems.description: The Puzzlebox has an effect based on the Winds of Magic roll. If the total rolled for the Winds of Magic is an odd number, add 1 dice to your power pool. If it is an even number, the bearer gains a +1 casting bonus this Magic phase.

magicItems.name: ABODE OF DJINN
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item may re-roll one Power Dice each spellcasting attempt. However, they also suffer a -1 casting penalty.

magicItems.name: TOME OF OMENS
magicItems.description: The wielder of this item may re-roll 1's when channelling power and dispel dice.

magicItems.name: BOOK OF IDOLS
magicItems.description: The bearer may reroll failed attempts of Genie Binding, and may summon them up to 12" away instead of 6".

magicItems.name: ARCANE WINDGLASS
magicItems.description: The bearer can use the Windglass immediately after your opponent has rolled the dice for the Winds of Magic. If they do so, your opponent must re-roll the result.

magicItems.name: SCROLLS OF RUQYAH
magicItems.description: This item contains the spell Healing Energy from the Lore of Light.

magicItems.name: CROWN OF SULTAN SHADDAD
magicItems.description: The wearer of this item gains the Inspiring Presence (6) special rule.

magicItems.name: THE GOLDEN CARAFE
magicItems.description: Enemy armours lose all magical bonuses against any close combat attacks made by the bearer; they count as mundane armours of their type. In addition, any successful enemy Ward saves must be re-rolled.

magicItems.name: LAMP OF ALA UD-DIN
magicItems.description: At the start of any of his turns, the bearer of this item may choose to summon a Genie of any type. The Genie must be placed within 6" of the bearer, at least 1" away from any units or impassable terrain. This Genie lasts until the start of the bearer's next turn.

magicItems.name: MASK OF THE FAITH
magicItems.description: This item gives the wearer the Terror special rule. In addition, Undead models treat this model as causing Fear against them, even though they are normally immune to Fear.

magicItems.name: CHALICE OF PAIN
magicItems.description: If the bearer of this item rolls a 5 or 6 To Hit with either close combat or missile weapons that Attack automatically Wounds.

magicItems.name: CLOAK OF SHADOWS
magicItems.description: Enemy missile attacks suffer -2 to hit to the wearer of this item.

magicItems.name: ECHO OF THE HATIF
magicItems.description: At the beginning of each of your turns, choose one friendly unit with the Zealotry special rule within 24" of the bearer. Until the beginning of your next turn, the chosen has the same Leadership Characteristic as the bearer of this item.

magicItems.name: HORN OF SHADHAVAR
magicItems.description: This item can be used at the start of any of your turns. Until the start of your next turn, all friendly units within 12" gain +1 Leadership.

magicItems.name: RING OF ALI AL-MAWLA
magicItems.description: The wearer and any unit they have joined gain the Immunity (Fear, Panic) special rule.

magicItems.name: ROPE OF KADIZAR
magicItems.description: The bearer may use this item at the start of their Remaining Moves phase instead of moving normally, as long as they are not in base contact with an enemy model or has moved previously this turn. The model can move to any location on the battlefield, but must be placed at least 1" away from enemy units and impassable terrain.

magicItems.name: STANDARD OF AL-HAIKK
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Fear special rule. In addition, all friendly units within 12" gains +1 to their Combat Resolution bonus.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE DESERT
magicItems.description: Enemies firing at the unit must re-roll successful To Hit rolls with their missile weapons. In addition, enemy units in base contact with the unit carrying this standard suffer -1 to their Weapon Skill.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE JEWELLED OASIS
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Vanguard special rule. In addition, they may re-roll failed rolls To Hit in close combat on any turn that they charge.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE DJINN
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard counts as being Ethereal for the purposes of Movement.

magicItems.name: ICON OF THE BLESSED WALI
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains a 6+ Ward save against non-Magical Attacks.

magicItems.name: STANDARD OF BEL-ALIAD
magicItems.description: At the start of each close combat phase, all enemy units in base contact with the unit carrying this standard suffer D6 Strength 3 Hits.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF HOLY FERVOUR
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains +1 to their Movement and Initiative characteristics.

magicItems.name: STANDARD OF THE STEED
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains +D3 to their charge and pursuit distances.
